messages:
Rae: Seeing ~20% of /generate POSTs still wrapped in legacy envelope. Runtime v6 will assume raw/streamed payloads only. We need a cheap, safe edge shim.

Miles: Prefer header-detection + small-body probe. Avoid full-body JSON parsing in hot path.

Dee: Header-only misses mobile clients. Logs show many old clients omit X-Client headers.

Priya: Proposal: Envoy filter that reads first 2KB, tries a tiny JSON probe for top-level 'envelope' or 'payload'. If found, rewrite body to payload and set a dynamic metadata flag; else passthrough. Bail on chunked/streaming or content-length > 64KB.

Liam: Safety: enforce parse timeout (~1ms), per-tenant token bucket for shim attempts, redact any parsed fields before emitting logs. Unit-test partial reads and malformed JSON.

Miles: Metrics: compat.shim.checked, compat.shim.rewritten, compat.shim.failed_parse, compat.shim.skipped_large. Tag by tenant/route. Alert if parse_fail_rate > 5% sustained.

Rae: Rollout: staging canary -> opt-in cohort (2w) -> auto-opt-in rule for tenants with >99% success over 7d -> gradual global enable with 60-day deprecation notice and emergency disable.

Dee: I'll write migration guide and small SDK patches. Priya to implement filter with flags, Liam to run perf/load tests. I will draft the customer notice.

ingest-bot: canary deploy started: edge/envelope-probe v0.2 -> staging at 1765440000 :rocket:
